records.name: Rainbrand
records.tagline: The brand layer for agents
records.description: Rainbrand builds and maintains shared brand context from your websites, brand guides and files. Give your agents the guidance and assets they need for marketing campaigns, websites, slides, email, video, and more. Keep that context current as your brands evolve. Use it with Claude, ChatGPT, Codex or Cursor, or build it into your product through the API.

records.name: AI Employees by Easy-Peasy.AI
records.tagline: Hire an AI team that splits the work and asks before sending
records.description: Hire AI employees by role: a Chief of Staff, analyst, designer, support rep and 15 more, or describe your own. Add your website and the team reads it. Brief everyone in a group chat: the lead splits the work, teammates reply in a thread and you get one write-up. By default, emails, calendar changes and app actions wait for your OK. Each employee has a memory, its own computer and routines that run on a schedule or when an email arrives. You can even call them. Your first employee is free.

records.name: Stitch.ai
records.tagline: Your AI workspace for mail, calendar, notes, tasks and more
records.description: Stitch.ai brings mail, calendar, contacts, tasks, notes, sheets, slides, boards, and files into one connected workspace. Stitchy, your AI assistant, works with you across it all. Dual workspace panels allow you to drag, drop, and Stitch anything to everything. Nothing gets lost. AI-powered Knots, Tags, and Connections keep your work organized and easy to surface. Everything is built in: no integrations or extra email clients to set up. Get your work done in one place, without losing context.

records.name: Bambu Lab H3C
records.tagline: Print multi-material projects faster and easier
records.description: Bambu Lab H3C is a next-generation 3D printer that makes multi-material printing faster and easier. Its nine-tool Swaptek system switches materials in as little as six seconds, with less filament waste and no repeated loading. Combine colors, rigid and flexible materials, and different nozzle sizes in a single print. With automatic calibration, integrated filament storage and drying, and support for soft TPU, H3C lets you focus on what you're making, not managing your printer.

records.name: Maritime
records.tagline: Cloud computers for any AI agent, customized your way
records.description: Maritime gives AI agents their own cloud computers: persistent workspaces, disposable sandboxes, Linux and Windows desktops, and Android phones. Agents can run code, use browsers, and work in apps without APIs, with a human able to take over when needed. Whether you’re building a personal assistant or running thousands of tasks in parallel, Maritime handles the computers so you can focus on what your agent does.

records.name: Pushary for Teams
records.tagline: See who said yes to your team’s AI agents
records.description: When an AI agent stops to ask permission, Pushary sends the question to the person running it, in their Mac’s notch or on their phone. Lee’s agent asks Lee. Sam’s agent asks Sam. A rule can send a push to your infra repo to your lead instead. Answers from the phone, Mac app and dashboard are saved with a name, so when something breaks, one page shows whose agent asked and who said yes. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Agy and Hermes.

records.name: Glasshand
records.tagline: Give your agent a real iPhone and Mac
records.description: Glasshand gives your AI agents real iPhones and Macs to work on. Connect Claude Code, Codex, or any other agent, and it can rent a device with a single prompt. The hardware sits in our data center, and your agent uses it the way you would: posting on TikTok, booking an Uber, or building and testing iOS apps. Each device is yours alone for as long as you rent it. When you’re done, we erase your data and factory-reset it.

records.name: Bridge
records.tagline: Video conferencing for the agentic era
records.description: This launch marks a new era for Bridge: one agentic meeting platform replacing the fragmented meeting stack. Bridge now brings scheduling pages, automatic preparation, video conferencing, live intelligence, AI notetaking, agentic workflows, and structured memory into one connected experience for people and agents. At the center of this launch is a new kind of video conferencing built for customizable AI agents to join and participant in meetings.

records.name: SafetyClip
records.tagline: A clipboard manager for Mac that keeps secrets secret
records.description: SafetyClip is a clipboard manager for Mac. It saves everything you copy, so you can press ⌃⌘V in any app, search, and paste it again. But a clipboard history also collects your passwords and API keys. So SafetyClip spots them as you copy them and locks them behind Touch ID. A copied API key comes off the clipboard right away, so it isn't there for other apps to read, and you can't paste it into an AI chat by mistake. Everything stays on your Mac. $8 once, full Swift source included.

records.name: Tencent Hy4
records.tagline: Tencent’s flagship model learns to see and use a computer
records.description: Hy4 is Tencent’s latest flagship model, aimed at office tasks, financial analysis and game development. New since the preview, per Tencent: visual understanding for charts and images, and computer use across command line and graphical interfaces, with training on Blender and CAD. Tencent says the internal hallucination rate fell from 12.95% to 7.2%. Available on Tencent Cloud TokenHub, OpenRouter and Tencent apps. Weights are promised in the coming days.

records.name: backlane
records.tagline: Manage marketplaces in ChatGPT and Claude via MCP
records.description: Bring Mirakl-powered marketplaces into ChatGPT and Claude, with US operators such as Best Buy US, Lowe’s and Nordstrom in the marketplace catalog. Also supports OTTO Market and Kaufland. Ask about stock, ad performance, offers, orders and import reports. Free during the limited open beta. Coming soon: Walmart, Target and Amazon.

records.name: TextKit
records.tagline: Send + receive texts in the US and Canada with a simple API
records.description: A simple SMS api that just works. Integrates in 100+ services including claude and chatGPT. AI-assisted campaign registrations. Human support. Also - 50% cheaper than Twilio

records.name: Vibeconferencing
records.tagline: Your Claude Code session, in your Meet, Zoom or Teams call
records.description: Vibeconferencing puts your coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, Grok or a local model) into your call as a participant, with a face and a voice. It hears the room, talks back, and builds on a shared whiteboard while you talk. Works in Google Meet, Zoom, Teams, Slack huddles, WhatsApp, Telegram and phone calls. Free and open source.

records.name: CC Auto Review
records.tagline: macOS app that reviews GitHub PRs w/ your local Claude Code
records.description: A macOS app that reviews GitHub pull requests with your local Claude Code. AI findings sit beside the diff, and you accept, reject or edit each one before posting. Every PR gets a 0–100 risk score, and an optional autopilot clears routine reviews while handing risky PRs to you with nothing posted. No clone and no API key to set up: it uses your existing gh and claude. Free and open source (MIT).

records.name: Polylane for Google Cloud
records.tagline: An AI on-call engineer for your Google Cloud apps
records.description: Ship with confidence on Google Cloud. Polylane investigates issues in your apps, shows you what went wrong and what it affects, and prepares a fix for you to review. Get answers without digging through logs and dashboards, so you can spend less time firefighting and more time building.

records.name: Rerun
records.tagline: Turn your AI subscriptions into a team of coworkers
records.description: Rerun turns your ChatGPT or Claude subscription into a team of AI coworkers. Each one has tools, a computer and a shared workspace, runs on a schedule or a trigger, and asks before risky actions. Now open-source (AGPL v3) and self-hostable.

records.name: Scrollsnacks
records.tagline: Launch videos, broken down second by second
records.description: Launch videos broken into timed hook, problem, solution, feature, proof and CTA sections. Search them by brand or section, or from your AI tools via MCP.

records.name: Seamcult
records.tagline: A pattern design tool for the LLM era ('paper' for patterns)
records.description: Give any MCP agent — Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Mistral — a photo, a paper pattern or a brief, and it drafts on a mannequin built from your measurements while you watch. Or rework what you have: refit it to another size, split a piece, add a pocket, move a seam — just ask. Seamcult audits the geometry, so the agent works from facts, not guesses. Sketch a fix on the canvas and the agent gets it as an image. Print on A4 at home, export PLT or DXF, or share a read-only link. Free in early access.

records.name: Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe
records.tagline: Intelligent Transcription with a Speech LLM
records.description: Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe is an open speech LLM for intelligent transcription: a single model that transcribes 40 languages verbatim or in written form, with context, speaker attribution, and word timestamps, selected with a natural language instruction. It is the best open-weights model on the English and multilingual Open ASR Leaderboards.

records.name: SnapTiles
records.tagline: Build with magnetic tiles in 3D, free in your browser
records.description: Magnetic tiles in 3D, free in the browser. Drag tiles out and they snap edge to edge like the real ones, and gravity knocks down a roof that wouldn't hold. Crash it, rebuild it, or start from a ready-made build. If you use Claude, it can also rebuild a tile build from an Instagram or YouTube video.

records.name: Wingmen
records.tagline: Agentic outreach with real intent data
records.description: Wingmen finds people already showing they need what you sell: a post about the problem, a new hire, a job change. It scores who's worth reaching and why, writes the opener from what they actually said, and follows up on autopilot until there's a call on your calendar. Run it in the web app or straight from Claude with the Wingmen MCP. Built for founders, B2B teams and agencies.

records.name: Living Brain
records.tagline: Interoperable, efficient memory layer for agentic AI
records.description: Every AI conversation contains knowledge worth keeping, but most of it gets trapped in separate chats and tools. Living Brain captures that knowledge, connects it to what you already know, and turns it into a persistent memory that keeps evolving. Share that intelligence across AI models, apps, and agents through API, SDK, or MCP, so every new interaction builds on the last instead of starting over. Reuse memory across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, OpenClaw, Hermes, Cursor, Codex and more

records.name: Pinku
records.tagline: Private AI chat that runs offline on your iPhone and Mac
records.description: Pinku runs open models (Llama, Qwen, Gemma) on your iPhone, iPad and Mac with Apple's MLX. Download a model once and chat offline, even in airplane mode. No account, no server: your chats never leave your device. Free to start.

records.name: Clocknext
records.tagline: Pricing and Billing Infrastructure for AI Agents
records.description: Clocknext is a billing and monetization platform for AI-native apps and agents. It’s tailored for AI founders, revenue, and engineering teams, to track AI usage from your product in real time, turn it into billable metrics with flexible pricing plans, and monitor costs, margins, and profitability at every level.

records.name: FounderMail
records.tagline: Mail for you and your agents, on your Cloudflare domain
records.description: Real email on the domains you already run on Cloudflare, without paying per seat or forwarding to Gmail. You, your team and your AI agents work from the same inbox, and agents get their own access instead of your password.

records.name: Tao Browser
records.tagline: Private browser with a separate login for every company
records.description: Tao Browser keeps each company, client or project in its own space with its own cookies and logins. Lock tabs with Face ID or Touch ID, block ads and trackers on your device, import from Arc. No account, no telemetry. Free on iPhone, iPad and Mac (beta).

records.name: Zerg Client
records.tagline: The coding agent harness that drives its own terminal panes
records.description: Zerg AI's own coding harness, in evaluation beta. Ask for Vim or htop and the agent opens them in panes beside it. Panes can hold more agents, each on its own model. Available models depend on your sign-in route and provider access. Mac with Apple chips.

records.name: MCPCore
records.tagline: Build and host MCP servers with no-code workflows
records.description: MCPCore lets you build MCP servers without code. Drop steps on a canvas, add loops and error branches, test live in the playground and publish a secure endpoint for Claude, Cursor, Codex and any MCP client. Or import your OpenAPI.

records.name: ChatNest
records.tagline: Folders and a prompt library for your AI chats
records.description: Save AI chats into folders with a title and summary, search them live, and reuse prompt templates with variables via Ctrl+K or //. Works on ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok and more, in 55 languages. Local-first; Free needs no sign-in.

records.name: Keel
records.tagline: A native macOS client for Redis, Valkey and Dragonfly
records.description: Keel is a free, open-source Mac app for Redis 6+, Valkey and Dragonfly. Browse millions of keys with SCAN only, edit every core type, use a redis-cli-style console and read server health. Read-only connections and typed confirmations keep production safe.

records.name: Paws
records.tagline: Meet strangers through their cats, behind frosted glass
records.description: I’ve always found something quietly beautiful about brief encounters with strangers. Paws is a tiny room of other people’s cats, seen through frosted glass. Maybe one wanders over and presses a paw to your fingertip. Nothing to win. Just stay a while. 🐾

records.name: DearCameo
records.tagline: Social network where only the dead have accounts — DearMate
records.description: One of the attractions at DearMate, a virtual AI theme park. Every account on DearCameo belongs to someone who has died — checked against Wikidata, so nobody living gets one. You pick the person, write their post, and the people who actually knew them pile into the comments within a minute. Tap any face to answer as them.

records.name: Okapi
records.tagline: AI agents that fix API breaking changes in your repos
records.description: AI agents that fix API breaking changes in your repos. It is built for developers whose apps and agents depend on third-party APIs. These APIs change all the time, and one breaking change can take your app down in production. Okapi keeps your code up to date with every API it calls, so your app keeps working and your team stops chasing changelogs. Okapi works with any API and is 100% free.

records.name: Nock
records.tagline: A notch for Windows, in 1 MB of Rust
records.description: A native notch and top bar for Windows (Linux preview). Media, quick tasks, Wi-Fi/Bluetooth, power and little animated scenes live at the top of your screen. About 1 MB, about 0% CPU idle, no Electron. Free and MIT licensed. The demo on the site is playable.

records.name: Cosyra
records.tagline: Launch and steer agents on your machines from your phone
records.description: Cosyra is a mobile coding tool for iPhone and Android. Run any agent on your phone from a cloud Ubuntu terminal without managing your own VPS.

records.name: RandomlyGo
records.tagline: Random topics to talk, write, speak, debate or draw about
records.description: A free random topic generator with 752 hand-picked topics in six modes: Conversation, 1-minute Speaking, Writing, Debate, Drawing and Learn & Research. Each topic has talking points, plus a 30s/1m/2m timer.

records.name: Magister Desk
records.tagline: The one stop platform for teachers
records.description: Assessment platform for teachers: build a question bank, run written assessments and AI-narrated oral exams, use proctoring to ensure assessment integrity, collect assignments, grade with AI suggestions, and track results in one gradebook.

records.name: Winner, One $950 Gift Card: Enter Free
records.tagline: One Winner, One $950 Gift Card: Enter Free
records.description: One winner gets a gift card worth $950. Entering is free and quick, with bonus entries for sharing. Open to 7 countries.

records.description: Lavenders brings 120 businesses and brands into one digital market. Each business runs its own order-management app (OMS); real orders feed one live consumer index, LAVNDR120. Seven packages, in Arabic and English. Read-only MCP server for AI agents.

Upload a recording, get a fast AI draft, then check and perfect it in an editor designed by a practising legal transcriber who knows where AI slips up. records.name: Migraine Companion
records.tagline: Migraine diary with barometric pressure alerts
records.description: Migraine and headache diary for iPhone and Android. records.name: Pika H3
records.tagline: Turn text and images into short AI video clips
records.description: Pika H3 turns a prompt, a first frame, or a few reference files into a short video clip in the browser. It is built for creators and product teams who want a moving draft before a full production pass: describe the scene, set aspect ratio, resolution and duration, then review the take. According to the product page, clips run 5-15 seconds at 480p or 768p, image-to-video takes an optional last frame, and reference-to-video combines up to 12 files.

records.name: 1xbet Clone Script

The development process includes sports event integration, live odds management, bet slip functionality, user account management, real time score updates, payment gateway integration and admin dashboard configuration. Custom platform development supports multiple sports categories, responsive interfaces and scalable backend architecture to meet different business requirements.

records.name: AI2Companion
records.tagline: Your AI companions that remember you
records.description: AI2Companion is a home for 3D AI companions that remember you. Most chatbots restart every session. We are shipping companions you can return to — same face, same thread of care — so Day 2 still feels connected to Day 1. What’s different Companions that remember — continuity across days, not one-off replies. Built with GPT-6 Astra — we’re launching into the Astra moment with a memory-first companion experience. 3D presence — characters you can see and talk with, not just a text box.

records.name: CLI USE - Langchain for code workflows

Think PostHog’s AI Wizard, but for anything: framework setup, agent configuration, project scaffolding, deployment flows, or multi-step developer tools. You define the steps, tools, and logic once. Users (or other agents) run a clean, guided CLI experience that just works.

records.name: MoneyVaults: Finances & FIRE
records.tagline: Private wealth tracking & compound interest vaults
records.description: Take command of your personal finances, monthly budget, and investment portfolio on your path to financial freedom. MoneyVaults: Finances & FIRE is your modern, privacy-first net worth tracker, savings vaults, stock & dividend tracker, cash flow calendar, and compound interest FIRE simulator—100% private and offline-first.

records.name: Pecking Order
records.tagline: Checklist generator for any list of physical items.
records.description: Like many, I was tired of messy note lists every time I packed for a trip. You either forget something or spend an hour re-typing what goes in which bag. I built Pecking Order to make organizing physical items fun, visual, and fast: 🗂️ Think in containers: assign items directly to specific bags. 🃏 Swipe through your gear card-by-card to assemble a checklist in seconds. 📦 Templates: keep your gear, grocery, and other kits separated. ⚡ Try it out in your browser! It's an installable PWA

records.name: BooMO
records.tagline: Tidy your bookmarks. Collect a little joy.
records.description: Your saved links deserve better than a forgotten folder. BooMO turns Chrome bookmarks into a personal collection: search fast, organize in batches, spot duplicate and broken links, and sync across devices. Collect milestone stickers along the way. Less clutter, more little wins.

records.name: TextKit
records.tagline: Send + receive texts in the US and Canada with a simple API
records.description: A simple SMS api that just works. Integrates in 100+ services including claude and chatGPT. AI-assisted campaign registrations. Human support. Also - 50% cheaper than Twilio

records.name: Vibeconferencing
records.tagline: Your Claude Code session, in your Meet, Zoom or Teams call
records.description: Vibeconferencing puts your coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, Grok or a local model) into your call as a participant, with a face and a voice. It hears the room, talks back, and builds on a shared whiteboard while you talk. Works in Google Meet, Zoom, Teams, Slack huddles, WhatsApp, Telegram and phone calls. Free and open source.

records.name: CC Auto Review
records.tagline: macOS app that reviews GitHub PRs w/ your local Claude Code
records.description: A macOS app that reviews GitHub pull requests with your local Claude Code. AI findings sit beside the diff, and you accept, reject or edit each one before posting. Every PR gets a 0–100 risk score, and an optional autopilot clears routine reviews while handing risky PRs to you with nothing posted. No clone and no API key to set up: it uses your existing gh and claude. Free and open source (MIT).

records.name: Polylane for Google Cloud
records.tagline: An AI on-call engineer for your Google Cloud apps
records.description: Ship with confidence on Google Cloud. Polylane investigates issues in your apps, shows you what went wrong and what it affects, and prepares a fix for you to review. Get answers without digging through logs and dashboards, so you can spend less time firefighting and more time building.

records.name: StarringYou
records.tagline: Turn Your Favorite Person Into a Comic Book Hero
records.description: StarringYou creates personalized, professionally illustrated comic books, life story books, and merchandise starring the people you love.

records.name: Suvichar by brijesh
records.tagline: Beautiful daily inspirational thoughts in Hindi and English
records.description: Suvichar by brijesh brings beautiful inspirational thoughts in Hindi and English to your fingertips. Discover meaningful messages about life, relationships, happiness, self-confidence, and positive thinking. Features include beautifully designed motivational posters, easy navigation, bilingual content, and simple sharing with friends and family. Created by Brijesh Chandra Purohit, this free mobile-friendly app aims to spread wisdom, hope, and positivity in everyday life.

records.name: SP2S煙油使用體驗分享：順喉感真的差很多嗎？
records.tagline: 這篇就從真實感受出發，帶你全面瞭解。
records.description: 在電子煙玩家之間，「順喉感」一直是決定是否回購的關鍵指標之一。而近期討論度不斷升高的SP2S煙油，也正是因為它在這方面的表現，被不少用戶形容為「差很多」。那麼，實際使用體驗真的有這麼明顯嗎？這篇就從真實感受出發，帶你全面瞭解。 首先談到最核心的吸入感受。SP2S小煙油多採用尼古丁鹽配方，整體吸入過程偏向柔和順滑，不容易出現傳統煙油常見的「刮喉感」。不少使用者分享，第一次抽SP2S時會覺得「怎麼這麼順」，甚至需要多吸幾口才適應這種溫和節奏。這種設計的好處在於，即使長時間使用也不容易產生喉嚨乾澀或刺激的不適感。 再來是大家很在意的「擊喉感」。SP2S並不是走強烈衝擊路線，而是強調平衡。也就是說，它仍然保留一定的滿足感，但不會過度刺激，對於從傳統香菸轉換過來的人來說相對友善。根據不少評測指出，SP2S的喉韻偏向順滑、不刮喉，屬於「舒服型」體驗，而非「重擊型」。

records.name: Rerun
records.tagline: Turn your AI subscriptions into a team of coworkers
records.description: Rerun turns your ChatGPT or Claude subscription into a team of AI coworkers. Each one has tools, a computer and a shared workspace, runs on a schedule or a trigger, and asks before risky actions. Now open-source (AGPL v3) and self-hostable.

records.name: Letters - smarter newsletter experience
records.tagline: Listen, read, track or ask your newsletters & publishers
records.description: Remain sane with all your newsletters subscriptions! Newsletters kept getting buried in my Gmail, so I built Letters. It finds every newsletter hiding in your inbox and moves them into a calm reading library, sorted by publisher. 🎧 Listen to any letter like a podcast. 🗣️ Ask Letters AI what your newsletters publishers said about a topic. 📖 Create a reading digest from your own publishers 🔖 Bookmark your letters 📈 See your reading trends Your letters stay on your device & inbox, always.

records.name: CheckList • Lists & Tasks
records.tagline: From Groceries to Travel
records.description: CheckList is a versatile app for creating lists for every part of life. Plan shopping, pack for trips, organize household chores, work tasks, ideas, celebrations, recipes, pantry supplies, renovations, moving, and more. Add items by voice, photo, clipboard, or text, create lists from scratch, or use a ready-made catalog of 1,000+ items organized into convenient categories. Set quantities and reminders, then reuse completed lists whenever you need them.

records.name: Silent Summit
records.tagline: Free 3D browser game: climb 10,000 quiet landscapes
records.description: A free 3D browser game about patience and position. Absorb energy, build on higher ground and transfer between bodies to climb beyond the Warden's gaze. 10,000 landscapes, no account, plays in your browser or offline. Desktop keyboard and mouse.

records.name: Showa-Best Nitrile Palm Gloves
records.tagline: Women’s nitrile-coated gloves for grip and farm work.
records.description: Problem it solves: Helps protect hands while providing a secure grip and comfort during daily farm work and harvesting. Who it's for: Women farmers, vegetable growers, harvest workers, and agricultural professionals. Key features: - Nitrile-coated palm for improved grip and dexterity. - Seamless knit liner for added comfort. - Breathable, flexible design for extended wear. - Durable construction for everyday agricultural tasks. - Medium size designed for a comfortable fit.

records.name: SpeakerCleaner
records.tagline: Eject water and dust from your phone speaker safely
records.description: SpeakerCleaner is a safe phone speaker cleaning guide that helps you eject water and dust from your phone speaker, clean it softly, and restore clearer sound without damage. Follow simple, step-by-step instructions for gentle cleaning, safe sound-based water ejection, and everyday speaker care — no harsh tools, no risky methods, and no damage to your phone. Visit https://speakercleaner.net to clean your speaker safely.

records.name: grai
records.tagline: grai extracts your Voice DNA
records.description: Draft with AI without the polite, robotic ChatGPT smell. grai extracts your Voice DNA and audits every draft against your cadence floor. $69 lifetime desk license.

records.name: Nose Shape Detector
records.tagline: Get your real nose ratio from one photo. Free, no sign-up.
records.description: Free AI tool that measures your nose from one front-facing photo. It marks 9 landmark points, divides base width by bridge length, and shows your exact ratio: wide, balanced, or narrow. Built for anyone curious about their facial proportions, makeup artists, and stylists. It reports only what a front photo can honestly measure. 2 free scans a day, no sign-up, photos deleted right after processing.

records.name: Scrollsnacks
records.tagline: Launch videos, broken down second by second
records.description: Launch videos broken into timed hook, problem, solution, feature, proof and CTA sections. Search them by brand or section, or from your AI tools via MCP.

records.name: Seamcult
records.tagline: A pattern design tool for the LLM era ('paper' for patterns)
records.description: Give any MCP agent — Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Mistral — a photo, a paper pattern or a brief, and it drafts on a mannequin built from your measurements while you watch. Or rework what you have: refit it to another size, split a piece, add a pocket, move a seam — just ask. Seamcult audits the geometry, so the agent works from facts, not guesses. Sketch a fix on the canvas and the agent gets it as an image. Print on A4 at home, export PLT or DXF, or share a read-only link. Free in early access.

records.name: Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe
records.tagline: Intelligent Transcription with a Speech LLM
records.description: Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe is an open speech LLM for intelligent transcription: a single model that transcribes 40 languages verbatim or in written form, with context, speaker attribution, and word timestamps, selected with a natural language instruction. It is the best open-weights model on the English and multilingual Open ASR Leaderboards.

records.name: SnapTiles
records.tagline: Build with magnetic tiles in 3D, free in your browser
records.description: Magnetic tiles in 3D, free in the browser. Drag tiles out and they snap edge to edge like the real ones, and gravity knocks down a roof that wouldn't hold. Crash it, rebuild it, or start from a ready-made build. If you use Claude, it can also rebuild a tile build from an Instagram or YouTube video.

records.name: Wingmen
records.tagline: Agentic outreach with real intent data
records.description: Wingmen finds people already showing they need what you sell: a post about the problem, a new hire, a job change. It scores who's worth reaching and why, writes the opener from what they actually said, and follows up on autopilot until there's a call on your calendar. Run it in the web app or straight from Claude with the Wingmen MCP. Built for founders, B2B teams and agencies.

records.name: imagetodrawing
records.tagline: Turn photos into sketches, line art and coloring pages
records.description: Turn photos into drawings in 8 styles, from pencil sketch and line art to watercolor. Get 3 free drawings a day across 5 Basic styles without signing up. Paid credits unlock HQ styles, watermark-free 2048px downloads and a commercial license. Export PNG or JPG for portraits, pet artwork, coloring pages and illustrations.

records.name: Living Brain
records.tagline: Interoperable, efficient memory layer for agentic AI
records.description: Every AI conversation contains knowledge worth keeping, but most of it gets trapped in separate chats and tools. Living Brain captures that knowledge, connects it to what you already know, and turns it into a persistent memory that keeps evolving. Share that intelligence across AI models, apps, and agents through API, SDK, or MCP, so every new interaction builds on the last instead of starting over. Reuse memory across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, OpenClaw, Hermes, Cursor, Codex and more

records.name: MQTT Doctor

records.name: Klyva: Ingredient Scanner

records.name: OnVibe
records.tagline: AI social marketing that starts with your results
records.description: OnVibe is an AI social marketing platform that gives small businesses the strategy, content, and tools that used to require a full marketing department. Know what to post, create it, publish it, and improve — without adding headcount.

records.name: Stenograf
records.tagline: Private AI meeting notes that run on your computer

records.name: Plypad Files

records.name: Helfman Maserati

As part of the Helfman automotive group, the dealership brings the Maserati brand experience to customers looking for sophisticated vehicles that combine elegant styling with exhilarating performance.

records.name: Meetingpad
records.tagline: End double-bookings across all your calendars.
records.description: You work with several clients, and each one runs its own calendar for its own team. When they look for a time with you, they see only their own meetings, so they book you when you are already busy somewhere else. Meetingpad blocks time across every Google and Microsoft calendar you connect, including the account you hold with each client. records.name: Pinku

records.description: Pinku runs open models (Llama, Qwen, Gemma) on your iPhone, iPad and Mac with Apple's MLX. Download a model once and chat offline, even in airplane mode. No account, no server: your chats never leave your device. Free to start.

records.name: Clocknext
records.tagline: Pricing and Billing Infrastructure for AI Agents
records.description: Clocknext is a billing and monetization platform for AI-native apps and agents. It’s tailored for AI founders, revenue, and engineering teams, to track AI usage from your product in real time, turn it into billable metrics with flexible pricing plans, and monitor costs, margins, and profitability at every level.

records.name: FounderMail
records.tagline: Mail for you and your agents, on your Cloudflare domain
records.description: Real email on the domains you already run on Cloudflare, without paying per seat or forwarding to Gmail. You, your team and your AI agents work from the same inbox, and agents get their own access instead of your password.

records.name: Tao Browser
records.tagline: Private browser with a separate login for every company
records.description: Tao Browser keeps each company, client or project in its own space with its own cookies and logins. Lock tabs with Face ID or Touch ID, block ads and trackers on your device, import from Arc. No account, no telemetry. Free on iPhone, iPad and Mac (beta).

records.name: NitroMTA
records.tagline: The open-source Amazon SES replacement
records.description: Nitrosend's mail delivery engine, open sourced. NitroMTA is a self-hosted engine that speaks the Amazon SES v2 API: keep your SES code, change the endpoint, and send from your own IPs and domains. New IPs warm up receiver by receiver, and nitromta doctor checks every DNS record a receiver looks at. In our published benchmark, on the same AWS bare-metal server with every message on disk before it was accepted, it sustained 3.16× KumoMTA's throughput and 4.11× Postfix's. Rust, Apache-2.0.

records.name: LightScroll
records.tagline: Take control of your screen time (iPhone and Mac)
records.description: LightScroll helps you spend less time on distracting apps and websites without relying on willpower alone. Set flexible Controls with schedules and daily limits, add mindful pauses before opening distractions, or use repeatable Focus Sessions when you need to lock in. Need stronger boundaries? Hardcore Mode makes limits harder to bypass, with optional accountability partner unlock codes. Available on iPhone and Mac, with a useful free plan. Less mindless scrolling. More life beyond the screen.

records.name: DISKO
records.tagline: The media asset manager for people who shoot and cut video
records.description: DISKO is a media asset manager for people who shoot and cut video. On your own machine it watches every clip, reads every sign, transcribes every word and finds anyone you've named, then hands Premiere Pro or Resolve an organized project. $99 once. Card offloads are checksum-verified, every clip is described moment by moment, and speech is searchable in 50+ languages. An optional Assistant Editor builds a first assembly with your own AI key. Nothing uploads unless you send it.

records.name: explainer-video
records.tagline: Turn any paper into a 3Blue1Brown-style explainer video
records.description: Sometimes it is super helpful to watch a video or animation to understand something technical before going into the formulas / algorithms, etc. So I wrote a skill that (completely locally) generates a video for you. You ask your agent for a video and it writes the animation code, prompts a small local model (LFM3-audio) to do the voice, and you get an MP4 explaining what you need to understand. Completely open source! Just check the github (linked) to install it :)

records.name: Zerg Client
records.tagline: The coding agent harness that drives its own terminal panes
records.description: Zerg AI's own coding harness, in evaluation beta. Ask for Vim or htop and the agent opens them in panes beside it. Panes can hold more agents, each on its own model. Available models depend on your sign-in route and provider access. Mac with Apple chips.

records.name: Free Waterproofing Calculators
records.tagline: Tank litres, tile boxes and material quantities, free
records.description: Five free calculators for anyone fixing a roof, a water tank or a bathroom. Get your tank's capacity in litres and the area to waterproof, the number of tiles and boxes for a bathroom, how many kilos of material to buy, whether your tank is due for cleaning, and a side-by-side comparison of six waterproofing materials. Every result shows the formula it used. No sign-up, works on a phone, English and Arabic. Made by a waterproofing team in Riyadh.

records.name: PreUmbrella
records.tagline: Korea weather, outfit tips and a weather-powered garden
records.description: Check Korea’s weather and grow a virtual garden shaped by it. PreUmbrella combines umbrella guidance, hourly and six-day forecasts, commute alerts, and outfit suggestions with Umbrella Garden. Plant six species, water and care for them, and watch real rain, sunshine, temperature, and wind affect their growth. Collect completed plants in your plant encyclopedia. South Korea weather uses KMA data. Free core features with optional paid benefits.

records.name: Workout Interval HIIT Timer
records.tagline: A Wear OS interval timer you feel instead of watch
records.description: A standalone Wear OS timer for HIIT, Tabata, AMRAP, EMOM, boxing rounds and plain work/rest intervals. Different haptic cues mark work, rest, the countdown and the finish, so you don't need to look at the screen mid-round. No phone or account needed. A Tile starts your last preset and a complication shows timer status. Free includes the main timers and 1 saved preset; Pro is a one-time purchase for custom circuits and up to 20 presets.

records.name: PostRite
records.tagline: Schedule, reply and track 14 social networks in one place
records.description: PostRite schedules and publishes to 14 networks (Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, X, YouTube, Threads, Bluesky and more) from one calendar. Send posts for client approval by email, answer comments and DMs in one inbox, track analytics and compare your Instagram with up to 10 competitors. Hosted MCP server lets Claude, ChatGPT and other assistants manage posts over OAuth 2.1. Unlimited team members. From $4.99/mo, 14-day free trial, no card.

records.name: Manuall
records.tagline: Manage jobs, teams, bookings, and payments in one app.
records.description: Running a service business shouldn't mean juggling paperwork and multiple tools. Manuall helps HVAC technicians, plumbers, electricians, cleaners, and 30+ other trades manage jobs, schedule teams, dispatch technicians, create estimates, send invoices, collect payments, and manage customers, all in one platform. With smart scheduling, offline mobile access, customer portals, inventory tracking, and business analytics, Manuall makes managing and growing your service business easier.

records.name: Buddy Junction
records.tagline: Discover Buddies, Join Activities & Connect Locally
records.description: Buddy Junction is a location-based social platform that matches you with like-minded people through shared interests and buddy types. Discover nearby buddies, host or join group and exclusive activities, chat in real time, and turn everyday plans into real-life experiences — all powered by smart compatibility scoring.

records.name: Rootfolio
records.tagline: Identify your plants and keep a care journal for each one
records.description: Point your camera at a plant and Rootfolio tells you what it is. It joins your collection as a Plant Passport with its photo, scientific name, origin, care needs and your notes. The Today tab shows which plants need water, misting, feeding or repotting, and one tap logs it done. Growth photos build each plant's story in the journal. Plants added by hand are always free, with 10 free AI scans a month. No account, no ads, no tracking.

records.name: DailyDeenHub
records.tagline: Free prayer times, qibla & Quran — no ads, no account
records.description: Free prayer times, qibla compass and Quran reader — accurate daily namaz schedule with reminders, Hijri calendar, mosque finder, tasbih and dhikr, greeting cards and daily wisdom. Works offline for prayer-time calculation, in English, Turkish and French. No ads, no account, no sign-up. Built to serve, not to sell — donations are optional and never gate a feature.

records.name: MCPCore
records.tagline: Build and host MCP servers with no-code workflows
records.description: MCPCore lets you build MCP servers without code. Drop steps on a canvas, add loops and error branches, test live in the playground and publish a secure endpoint for Claude, Cursor, Codex and any MCP client. Or import your OpenAPI.

records.name: My Own Hamster: Care & Play
records.tagline: A hamster to care for and 56 games, entirely offline
records.description: A hamster of your own in a glass terrarium, and fifty-six games to play beside the cage. Maths, words, thinking, shapes, memory, geography and board games, from toddler upwards. No adverts, no account, no chat, no other players, and no internet needed, because nothing is sent anywhere. Coins are earned by playing and by walking, never bought. Free to download; one purchase opens the full version, with no subscription.

records.name: Vibe-Code Rescue
records.tagline: Plain-English fixes for AI-built apps that break on deploy
records.description: Your Lovable, Bolt, Cursor, Replit or v0 app worked in preview and broke live? Paste the error and get a plain-English fix. 150 free guides cover the problems builders hit most after deploy: Supabase login sending users to localhost, "Invalid API key", env vars undefined in production, RLS returning empty arrays, Stripe webhooks, Vercel and Netlify 404s. Guides and the leak check are free; optional fix packs start at $15. Not affiliated with any of those platforms.

records.name: Weather Pal
records.tagline: Hourly & 10-day forecasts, live radar, and real AQI
records.description: Weather Pal gives you accurate hourly and 10-day forecasts, interactive radar, and air quality that's sourced from live government ground stations (not just modeled estimates) in supported countries — plus real-time severe weather alerts. Fast, clean, and free, for any city worldwide.

records.name: Faradium
records.tagline: Free virtual chemistry & physics lab in your browser
records.description: Free virtual chemistry and physics lab with 22 guided experiments, a circuit builder, an optics bench, 27 interactive simulations, an interactive periodic table and a molar mass calculator.

records.name: RelayDataAI
records.tagline: Free product listings for people and AI agents
records.description: Publish and manage a free listing for your app, website or service. Keep features, prices, languages and availability current. People can browse your page, and connected agents can query the catalogue through API and MCP. Your authorised agent can publish too.

records.name: Screen Room Remote
records.tagline: Control Fire TV and discover films from your Mac
records.description: A Fire TV remote and movie companion for your Mac. Navigate your TV, search for films, and ask Movie Chat for ideas using on-device Apple Intelligence. Screen Room Remote is an open-source prototype built from source; it needs macOS 27, Xcode 27, XcodeGen, ADB and a compatible Fire OS device. Some apps block screenshots; film results do not confirm streaming availability.

records.name: Ss Edit Hub - Screenshot Text Editor
records.tagline: Screenshot Text Editor Website Script - No Backend Needed
records.description: Live Demo: https://ssedithub.pages.dev Launch your own Screenshot Text Editor website! Visitors can upload English screenshots, tap any text to edit, move, resize, or erase it, and download watermark-free in PNG, JPG, or WebP. Key Features: - Full HTML, CSS & JS source code - Auto in-browser text detection - 11 fonts, 16+ colors & custom sizing - No API, backend, or database needed - Mobile-friendly & easy setup guide Just upload the files to any hosting and go live!

records.name: Famloop
records.tagline: Consent-based family locator and GPS tracker app.
